business_summary: Phoenix Media Investment (Holdings) Limited, an investment holding company, provides satellite television broadcasting services in the People's Republic of China and internationally. The company operates through five segments: Television Broadcasting, Internet Media, Outdoor Media, Real Estate, and Other Businesses. The Television Broadcasting segment engages in satellite broadcasting television programs and commercials; and the provision of promotion activities through the operation of Phoenix Chinese and Phoenix InfoNews channels, as well as Phoenix Movies, Phoenix North America Chinese, Phoenix Chinese News and Entertainment, Phoenix Hong Kong, integrated media operating platform, and other channels. The Internet Media segment offers website portal and value-added telecommunication services. The Outdoor Media segment provides outdoor advertising services. The Real Estate segment is involved in property development and investment activities. The Other Activities segment offers program production and ancillary, merchandising, magazine publication and circulation, and other related services. The company also involves in the provision of management, radio broadcasting, promotional and related consulting, cultural development, trademark and property holding, circulation of periodicals, technical consulting, publication, games production and development, mobile value-added, media technology development and advertising, aircraft chartering, research and development, software application development, financial consulting, investment management, hotel management, and exhibition services. The company was founded in 1996 and is headquartered in Tai Po, Hong Kong.
business_summary_ko: 투자 지주 회사인 Phoenix Media Investment (Holdings) Limited는 중화인민공화국과 국제적으로 위성 TV 방송 서비스를 제공합니다. 이 회사는 텔레비전 방송, 인터넷 미디어, 옥외 미디어, 부동산 및 기타 사업 등 5개 부문을 통해 운영됩니다. 텔레비전 방송 부문은 위성 방송 텔레비전 프로그램 및 광고에 종사합니다. Phoenix Chinese 및 Phoenix InfoNews 채널과 Phoenix Movies, Phoenix North America Chinese, Phoenix Chinese News and Entertainment, Phoenix Hong Kong, 통합 미디어 운영 플랫폼 및 기타 채널의 운영을 통한 홍보 활동 제공. 인터넷 미디어 부문은 웹사이트 포털과 부가 가치 통신 서비스를 제공합니다. 옥외미디어부문은 옥외광고 서비스를 제공합니다. 부동산 부문은 부동산 개발 및 투자 활동에 관여합니다. 기타 활동 부문은 프로그램 제작 및 보조, 상품화, 잡지 출판 및 배포, 기타 관련 서비스를 제공합니다. 회사는 또한 관리, 라디오 방송, 홍보 서비스 제공에도 참여합니다.
